https://github.com/taxmeifyoucan/filters

This is just an experiment I wanted to share, built a prototype of an idea I had for a while. It's local block filters, basically you can connect to any RPC and instead of asking for your wallet address, you download the whole block, process it locally to build a filter - a structure like 100x smaller than block itself that still lets you easily find your transactions. It has certain limitations but I believe it's an interesting concept that can be explored and maybe implemented further
